cells.gaps: No fact says how many of the 35 district offices and 17 on-site points enter records in the BDRS (BWA-004), and the newest fact on how the record is made (BWA-003) does not say in terms that it is keyed at the office; the only count is 13 hospitals in 2015 (BWA-023). No plan is held inside 36 months: the 2021-2026 CRVS plan is only scheduled in a 2019 document (BWA-017). The kiosk closures (BWA-010) are undated, and BWA-015 reports an online service built but not live.
cells.note: Stage 3: the BDRS registers births and deaths nationally, but the share of local offices entering in it is not published. Stage 4 needs more than half of offices on a share or a count with a denominator, and words saying the entry is made at the office.
